Session Smart HA Conductor on Azure

Deployment file builder: everything runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
Read how the automation works, then fill in the inputs.

Click a file to review its contents. The bundle is the MOP plus the five deployment files.

MOP commands

The procedure from MOP.md. Azure Cloud Shell (PowerShell) is only used to deploy the VMs, from the directory holding the five deployment files. Every node step runs in an SSH root shell on that node, or in the node0 PCLI (opened from the root shell with su - admin); paste multi-line blocks as a whole. Wait for the expected result of each step before running the next, and expect each node to reboot by itself during initialization.

    Generate password hash

    Creates a SHA-512 crypt hash ($6$…) with a random salt, locally in this browser. The clear-text password is not stored.
